summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing for Context app. Backend: 16/16 pytest tests PASSED including auth, billing/Stripe checkout (real session created), /explain (Claude Haiku returns structured JSON), library CRUD, transcribe auth gate. Frontend (Expo Web mobile viewport 390x844): login flow works, all 5 tabs render correctly (Home/Online/Live/Library/Settings), record-btn is exactly 120x120 with purple gradient and 'Tocca per iniziare' label on both /online and /live, Live tab shows large-text event mode, Library groups by domain (Finance:1), upgrade-btn opens real https://checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_test_... in a new tab, logout-btn present. /explain via curl returns proper {word,definition,domain,what_to_say,language} for 'M&A' → Finance. Auto-save: SubtitlesEngine.tsx calls both /explain and /library/save (lines 159/162) so word click flow is wired correctly. Microphone recording itself cannot be functionally validated through Playwright/web preview (MediaRecorder + permission UI) — this is expected per task note; logic server-side is verified. Minor RN-web console warnings only (shadow*, pointerEvents, useNativeDriver) — non-blocking.

issues: React Native Web deprecation warnings in console: 'shadow*' style props (use boxShadow), props.pointerEvents (use style.pointerEvents), Animated useNativeDriver missing RCTAnimation. These do NOT break functionality but pollute logs.

action_items: Optional: silence RN-web deprecation warnings by migrating shadow* styles to boxShadow and pointerEvents prop to style.pointerEvents in components (cosmetic only).

Microphone capture cannot be exercised in headless web preview — recommend validating end-to-end record→transcribe flow on a native build (Expo Go / EAS build) where MediaRecorder/expo-audio is fully functional.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /api/explain does NOT itself persist the word; frontend SubtitlesEngine.tsx calls /library/save separately after /explain. This is correctly implemented but consider server-side auto-save to make the contract single-call and atomic.
server.py uses @app.on_event('shutdown') which is deprecated in modern FastAPI; consider lifespan handlers.
STRIPE_API_KEY='sk_test_emergent' is the Emergent test wrapper and IS working — checkout sessions created successfully (verified live with real cs_test_... URL).
All MongoDB queries correctly exclude _id. JWT auth, password hashing, and trial logic look solid.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on testable surface (mic capture not testable on web)

seed_data_creation: Used existing seeded user test@context.app / test12345. Test class fixtures create/cleanup TEST_ prefixed words.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend stable at 16/16. Frontend mobile UI verified at 390x844 viewport. Stripe upgrade flow opens real Stripe checkout in new tab. For deeper recording validation, test on native Expo Go build — web preview cannot drive MediaRecorder reliably in Playwright.
